title: The Hotel
content: The hotel is a place I visit often. And I always start at the elevator. The elevator is very small and makes me feel extremely panicked (I have severe claustrophobia). The hotel also has a restaurant that I go to and it is very dark and moody in there. All of the interior of the main hotel is red and white and the only staff I have met was a waitress who seemed upset that I handed her a gold card. When I try to leave I am always late for a bus.
